message.reasoning_content:
The watch is an Omega Speedmaster Professional Moonwatch. The dial looks like the black dial with three subdials, applied logo (metal "OMEGA" logo), which suggests the newer 3861 movement version. The bracelet appears to be a metal bracelet — actually it looks like a "flat link" or the new 3861 bracelet. Hmm, the bracelet in the photo looks like a beads-of-rice / five-link style? Look at the bracelet: it appears to have multiple rows of links — could be the new 3861 bracelet which is a five-row? Actually the new Moonwatch bracelet has three rows with polished center. The photo shows something like a five-link... Hmm, the bracelet looks like a "beads of rice" style — maybe it's actually aftermarket. But the reference for the current Moonwatch with bracelet is 310.30.42.50.01.001. The hesalite version with bracelet is 310.30.42.50.01.001; the sapphire version is 310.30.42.50.01.002.

The dial appears to have a stepped dial? Hard to tell. The applied metal logo indicates 3861 movement. The tachymeter bezel with "TACHYMÈTRE" and dot over 90 — the dot over 90 is present on the 3861 version (also on earlier ones). Bezel appears to be aluminum with dot over 90 → 3861 caliber Moonwatch.

The crystal: looks like hesalite dome? The dial is quite clear without milky ring... Can't be sure. I'd go with the hesalite 310.30.42.50.01.001.

Hmm, subdials: 3 o'clock 30-minute, 6 o'clock 12-hour, 9 o'clock small seconds. Yes that matches Speedmaster Professional.

Reference: 310.30.42.50.01.001 is the Moonwatch Professional Co-Axial Master Chronometer Chronograph 42mm steel on steel, hesalite. Actually with bracelet, references: 310.30.42.50.01.001 (hesalite, steel bracelet), 310.30.42.50.01.002 (sapphire, steel bracelet). Hmm, I think:
- 310.30.42.50.01.001 = hesalite on steel bracelet
- 310.30.42.50.01.002 = hesalite?? Let me recall: The sapphire sandwich with bracelet is 310.30.42.50.01.002. Yes.

Confidence ~0.5.

Movement: automatic? No — the Speedmaster Professional Moonwatch is manual winding (caliber 3861 manual). So movement: manual.

Case material: stainless-steel. Bracelet: metal.

Brand Omega, model family "Speedmaster Professional Moonwatch".
